text:
anya: quick heads-up 1: small cluster of fncall unparseable errors in canary (eu-central). saw this in logs:
```
{
  "error": "unparseable",
  "detail": "payload is a JSON-string, expected object",
  "validator": "validate-v6"
}
```
any idea if clients changed or validator got stricter? tagging @derek @sophia

derek: thanks. which rollout is validate-v6 on? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary metadata: feature=validate-v6, region=eu-central, rollout_pct=6, status=running

sophia: telemetry note: these events often miss route_id when validation runs before auth/routing. that makes it hard to map to API keys. we should capture `auth_hint` (api_key masked) on validation events.

anya: short-term mitigation options: 1) soft-fail (log + pass) 2) mediate by trying JSON.parse on top-level string and proceed if parse succeeds 3) keep strict and page customers. I prefer mediate for better UX but only if we emit clear audit events.

derek: mediate is fine if we: a) tag mediation_applied=true and orig_error=UNPARSEABLE; b) include mediation_kind=STRING_TO_JSON; c) preserve original route attribution (preserve_route=true) when auth is present. Also add metric fncall.mediation.count.

sophia: will add event fields and an alert: page eng-oncall if mediation_rate > 0.4% OR rejects > 0.5% for 10m. sampling full redacted payloads at 2% for mediated events so we can debug. PR: https://git.internal/repo/telemetry/PR-401

ops-oncall: ensure quota attribution doesn't move to fallback if we mediate. if preserve_route isn't possible (no auth), route to fallback and emit attribution_mode=ASYNC_RESOLVE. page ops if unexpected quota deltas appear.

derek: rollout plan: enable MEDIATE_STRING in canary at 5% in eu-central, collect metrics for 24h, then evaluate. add rollback toggle to console rollout feed. ticket INF-5410 to track mediate experiment + dashboard panel (rejects vs mediation).

deploy-bot: Feature update: validate-v6 mode=MEDIATE_STRING, rollout_pct=5 in eu-central. Change recorded at 2024-10-14T09:02:10Z

anya: i'll collect a few redacted samples and attach to INF-5410. also will draft console copy: "We auto-parsed a string payload into JSON. If you'd prefer strict validation, disable mediation on your API key."

sophia: adding dashboard rows: "fncall: mediation applied by account", "top mediation reasons", and a table linking validator_version + mediation_rate. will include sampling knobs.

derek: adding quick unit-tests for string->json coercion edgecases. also adding quota ingest check for preserve_route auth signature. PR links in INF-5410.

anya: thanks team. keeping follow-ups in INF-5410. closing this thread. :thumbsup:
